description:
One market's taker fills of 100 USD or more, newest first, from 0xinsider's own record of the exchange's on-chain fills: each fill once, keyed by its transaction hash and log index. Walk a window with from and to and page with next_cursor. Fills under 100 USD are not stored. coverage.recorded_from is where the record starts, the later of when recording began and 00:00 UTC on the day 365 days back, so an empty window before it means outside the record, not no trading; coverage.complete_through is how far the record is complete, a few minutes behind now, and a first page serves no fill after it. For large trades with grades and review scores, use get_large_trades_history with condition_id.

Args:
  - condition_id (string, required): Raw provider condition_id or the mkt_-prefixed market id
  - from (string, optional): Inclusive RFC3339 lower bound on traded_at; omitted, the walk runs to the start of the record
  - to (string, optional): Exclusive RFC3339 upper bound on traded_at; a first page ends at the earlier of to and coverage.complete_through
  - limit (number, 1-500, default 100): Fills per page
  - cursor (string, optional): next_cursor from the previous page, bound to the same market, from and to

Returns: data (each fill's id, traded_at, side BUY or SELL for the taker, outcome, outcome_index, token_id, price, shares, size_usd, taker, transaction_hash and log_index), has_more, next_cursor, condition_id, coverage (min_size_usd, recorded_from, complete_through, retention_days) and meta. A 503 read_model_warming means retry after Retry-After; an unknown market answers not_found.

condition_id.description: Raw provider condition_id or the mkt_-prefixed market id

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page; it is bound to the same market, from and to

from.description: Inclusive RFC3339 lower bound on traded_at; omitted, the walk runs to the start of the record

to.description: Exclusive RFC3339 upper bound on traded_at; a first page ends at the earlier of to and coverage.complete_through

name: get_market_trades
title: List a market's trades
